$projectDir = Join-Path $root "projects\$Name"
$plannerPath = Join-Path $root "PLANNER.md"

$today = Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd"
$displayName = ($Name -replace '[-_]', ' ')

# YouTube Production Planner

A folder-and-Markdown system for planning and editing YouTube videos in
CapCut, with AI-assisted scripting, B-roll/thumbnail prompts, and
per-style edit checklists.

## Layout

- **[PLANNER.md](PLANNER.md)** - the master board. One table per stage
  (Idea, Scripting, Filming/Sourcing, Editing (CapCut), Review, Published).
  Move a project's row down the file as it advances.
- **projects/** - one folder per video, each holding:
  - `NOTES.md` - brief, hook ideas, references, status log
  - `SCRIPT.md` - outline + full draft, with AI-prompt pointers
  - `EDIT-CHECKLIST.md` - the CapCut edit checklist for this video
  - `ASSETS.md` - table of every AI-generated asset (B-roll, voiceover,
    thumbnail) with the prompt used, so it can be regenerated later
- **templates/project/** - the blank versions of the four files above,
  copied when you scaffold a new project
- **library/prompts/** - reusable prompt templates: `script-ideas.md`,
  `broll-prompts.md`, `thumbnail-prompts.md`
- **library/checklists/** - CapCut edit checklists by video style:
  `talking-head.md`, `tutorial-howto.md`, `montage-highlight.md`,
  `shorts-vertical.md`
- **scripts/new-project.ps1** - scaffolds a new project folder and adds it
  to the Idea table in PLANNER.md

## Starting a new video

```bash
powershell -File scripts/new-project.ps1 -Name "my-video-slug" -Style "Talking Head" -Priority "High" -TargetLength "8 min"
```

Then open `projects/my-video-slug/NOTES.md` and fill in the brief. Use
`library/prompts/script-ideas.md` to draft the outline and script with an
AI assistant, copy the matching checklist from `library/checklists/` into
`EDIT-CHECKLIST.md`, and log any AI-generated assets in `ASSETS.md` as you
create them.

## Workflow

1. **Idea** - brief filled in, hook drafted
2. **Scripting** - outline -> draft -> locked script
3. **Filming / Sourcing** - record footage and/or generate AI B-roll
4. **Editing (CapCut)** - work through the style checklist
5. **Review** - watch-through + QA checklist
6. **Published** - link and performance notes logged

Move the project's row in PLANNER.md to the matching table as it advances.

This directory is a folder-and-Markdown planning system for YouTube videos
edited in CapCut, with AI-assisted scripting and asset generation. See
README.md for the full layout.

## Conventions to follow when helping in this directory

- **New video project** -> run `scripts/new-project.ps1 -Name "<slug>"`
  (kebab-case slug) rather than hand-copying the template. Pass `-Style`,
  `-Priority`, `-TargetLength` when known.
- **Moving a project between stages** -> cut its row from the current
  stage table in PLANNER.md and paste it into the next stage table (Idea ->
  Scripting -> Filming/Sourcing -> Editing (CapCut) -> Review -> Published).
  Don't just add a new row - remove it from the old table too.
- **Adding a loose idea** (not ready for a full project folder) -> add it
  as a bullet under "Backlog / Someday" at the bottom of PLANNER.md.
- **Writing/refining scripts** -> use the prompt templates in
  `library/prompts/script-ideas.md` as a starting point, write the result
  into that project's `SCRIPT.md`, and mark AI-drafted vs. reviewed text
  with the `[AI-DRAFT]` / `[FINAL]` markers already in the template.
- **AI-generated B-roll, voiceover, or thumbnails** -> always log them in
  that project's `ASSETS.md` (tool, prompt, file, status) so they're
  reproducible later. Use `library/prompts/broll-prompts.md` and
  `thumbnail-prompts.md` for prompt starting points.
- **Edit checklists** -> copy the relevant style checklist from
  `library/checklists/` into the project's `EDIT-CHECKLIST.md` rather than
  editing the shared library file. Project-specific overrides go under
  "Custom steps," the shared checklist stays generic and reusable.
- **New video style** (not talking-head/tutorial/montage/shorts) -> add a
  new file to `library/checklists/` following the existing format
  (Prep / Rough cut / Polish / AI-assisted steps / Finish) rather than
  cramming it into an existing checklist.

This is a Windows environment; `scripts/new-project.ps1` runs under
Windows PowerShell 5.1. All content in this repo (PLANNER.md, templates,
library) is kept plain-ASCII on purpose (no em-dashes, curly quotes, or
arrows) - PowerShell 5.1's default text encoding does not round-trip
UTF-8 multibyte characters cleanly through `Get-Content`/`Set-Content`,
which previously corrupted PLANNER.md into mojibake. Keep new content
ASCII-only (use `--` instead of an em-dash, `->` instead of an arrow) so
the scaffold script stays safe to run.
